subtitle: On-device AI assistant
promotional_text: Chat with AI on your phone, even offline. Local chats stay on your device; sign in for AGI Cloud when you want more.
description:
AGI is an AI assistant that runs on your phone first.

LOCAL MODE
• Chat with an on-device model, even offline or in airplane mode
• No account needed; local chats stay on this device, encrypted at rest
• Supported devices use a built-in model; others download one once

AGI CLOUD (optional, sign-in)
• Cloud chat and web search on the Free plan
• Projects, memory and skills on the Free plan
• The app is free and has no in-app purchases

PRIVACY
• Cloud messages go to the AI provider that serves the request
• Choose which models may be used in Settings > Privacy
• Export or delete your data any time in Settings
• India DPDP notice and open items: https://agiworkforce.com/trust

Built by AGI Automation LLC, USA.
Support: support@agiworkforce.com
Privacy: https://agiworkforce.com/privacy
Terms: https://agiworkforce.com/terms

questionnaire.user_generated_content: Yes: projects and agents shared by people you work with; Report and Hide are in the app

age_rating.note: Answers account for what an AI chatbot and image generator can produce (Apple age-rating notice, 2025: https://developer.apple.com/news/?id=ks775ehf), mirroring ChatGPT's App Store rating (13+, infrequent mature, violence and medical descriptors, checked 2026-10-19). If App Store Connect calculates below 13+, use Override to Higher Age Rating: 13+, because AGI Cloud accounts are 13 and over (ACCOUNT_MINIMUM_AGE, packages/contracts/types/src/account-eligibility.ts; 16 in EU zones and North Macedonia, 18 in India and Brazil via ageGate.ts). Unrestricted web access is No: links open in the system browser, the app has no address bar. Shared chat links are read on the web, not inside the app.

data_linked_to_you.collected_when: Only when the user signs in to use AGI Cloud. Email is required to create the account; name is collected if provided by the sign-in method.
Only in AGI Cloud: the messages the user sends and any photos or files attached to them are uploaded to AGI Cloud and forwarded to the model provider serving the request. Local Mode uploads nothing.

Only during live voice mode in an AGI Cloud chat: the microphone is streamed to AGI Cloud for the session and the transcript is saved to that chat. Dictation and the turn-based voice companion transcribe on the device and upload no audio.

Only after sign-in: the account identifier on every authenticated cloud request, and an app-generated device UUID registered with the push token so notifications reach the right install. No advertising identifier is collected.

Only in AGI Cloud and only after the user allows product analytics in Settings, Privacy (off by default; a workspace administrator can also turn it off): event names such as a stopped or regenerated response, recorded against the account. No message, file or file name is included. Local Mode sends none.

privacy_nutrition_labels.note: Local Mode collects no personal data by default and uploads nothing. Signing in to AGI Cloud collects account email, optional name, account and device identifiers, and the conversation content and attachments the user sends; product interaction events are added only when the user allows product analytics. Conversation content is processed by the model-provider subprocessors listed at https://agiworkforce.com/subprocessors on AGI's behalf; it is never used to track the user across other companies' apps or websites.

pricing.in_app_purchase_note: Version 1 sells nothing. apps/mobile/src/features/billing/storePurchases.json sets "nativePurchases": false, and src/features/billing/nativePurchaseAvailability.ts exports it as NATIVE_PURCHASES_AVAILABLE, which every purchase path reads. With it false the app shows no purchase, upgrade, top-up, restore-purchases, compare-plans or contact-sales control and no price; useMobileIap.ts picks an inert implementation at build time, so the app never opens a StoreKit connection; mobileIapService.ts refuses catalog and verify calls and never reads the App Store storefront, so the app never calls /api/mobile/iap/*. The purchase client library expo-iap is still linked into the binary and its config plugin is still registered in app.config.js, but nothing calls it. On the server the /api/mobile/iap/* routes (owner mobile-iap-catalog.ts) stay off unless the deployment sets MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED. Do not attach in-app purchase products to this version in App Store Connect. Settings > Subscription opens a screen titled Plan: current plan, renewal or end date if any, a plain-text Billing line ("Managed on the web", "By your organization" or "Managed where you subscribed") for an account that already holds a paid plan, "What your plan includes", "Usage" and "Help with your plan", which opens in-app support. A feature outside the account's plan is described as not included in the plan, with no call to action. Paid plans exist for the web product; an account that already holds one gets that plan's access after signing in, and the app neither sells nor advertises them. Selling in the app needs nativePurchases set to true, a new store build and a new review.
pricing.guideline_3_1_1_residual_risk: Version 1 has no in-app purchases (apps/mobile/src/features/billing/storePurchases.json, "nativePurchases": false) and no link to a page about purchasing, pricing, billing, invoices, sales or upgrades. The source still contains web billing and workspace administration links (View invoices, Workspace administration, Manage on web and Help with a purchase in cloud-billing/index.tsx, Contact Sales in PaywallBottomSheet.tsx, and the website workspace links in settings/workspace.tsx), but none renders in this build: Settings > Subscription returns the Plan screen before the purchase screen that holds most of them, the chat sheet draws no action while NATIVE_PURCHASES_AVAILABLE is false, and the rest require useWebBillingLinksAllowed to read a US App Store storefront, which this build never reads. An account that already holds a paid plan sees its Billing line as plain text with no link. The Stripe billing portal is unreachable while FEATURES.billing is false. The external links that remain are legal pages (Terms, Privacy, acceptable use, data use, security), support, the account page behind the Change your email alert, password recovery and the GitHub connect flow, listed in REVIEWER-NOTES-IOS.md; each passes through the HTTPS host allowlist in lib/safeOpenURL.ts. These links and App Review purchase policy need a current signed-build review before submission.

export_compliance.info_plist_key: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=false, declared in ios.infoPlist in apps/mobile/app.config.js
export_compliance.basis: All cryptography is Apple OS-provided: TLS via URLSession, Keychain via expo-secure-store, SecRandomCopyBytes via expo-crypto, and SQLCipher compiled with -DSQLCIPHER_CRYPTO_CC (ExpoSQLite.podspec) so its codec calls Apple CommonCrypto. No proprietary or bundled third-party cipher ships in apps/mobile. Flip to true and obtain an export-compliance code if that ever changes.

availability.territories: All App Store territories excluding: Mainland China, Russia, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Crimea
